exercises.explanationUz:
BU BET - GRAMMAR 2 KITOBINING ORQA
MUQOVASI.

  Mashq yo'q, bet raqami ham yo'q.
  Bu bet bilan Grammar 2 (86 skan,
  95 bet) TO'LIQ TUGAYDI.


KITOB HAQIDAGI TAVSIF:

  'Enterprise Grammar 2 gives
   students at Elementary level
   clear explanations and practice
   of English grammar.'

  TARJIMASI:
  'Enterprise Grammar 2 Elementary
   darajadagi o'quvchilarga ingliz
   tili grammatikasining aniq
   tushuntirishlari va mashqlarini
   beradi.'


ASOSIY XUSUSIYATLARI (Key
features):

  • clear simple explanations and
    examples - aniq, sodda
    tushuntirish va misollar
  • a variety of stimulating
    exercises - turli qiziqarli
    mashqlar
  • lively illustrations - jonli
    rasmlar
  • revision sections within each
    unit - har unit ichida
    takrorlash bo'limi
  • progress tests - nazorat
    testlari


TARKIBI (Components):

  Enterprise Grammar 2 Student's
    Book - o'quvchi kitobi (shu
    kitob)
  Enterprise Grammar 2 Teacher's
    Book - o'qituvchi kitobi
    (javoblar bilan)


⚠ 'GIVES ... EXPLANATIONS':

  give + KIMGA + NIMA - 'gives
  students explanations' = o'quvchi-
  larga tushuntirish beradi.
